purpose: Canonical source provenance and on-demand external export; not a build input or binary-reproducibility claim.
excludedDependencies: Full symbol databases and monolithic Black2Upgrade implementation
normalization: UTF-8 text with LF endings and a final newline; machine-specific paths are replaced with <LOCAL_PATH>. Binary PNG build inputs are copied byte-for-byte.

Canonical sources remain in Pokeweb runtime/learnset-viewer.

patches.name: bgm-toggle
patches.title: Background-music toggle and streamed replacement
patches.note: Shared US Black 2 / White 2 runtime 3.0.0 for a volume-mute shortcut and a variable-length table of native SDAT stream replacements. ABI 1 single-track migration, per-track updates/removal, and export/reimport are supported. Uses one guarded 32 KiB native output buffer, 4 KiB low-memory fallback, and native heap rollback. The installer retains its 512 MiB export safety limit. Multi-track gameplay verification is pending; host and archive checks do not certify playback.
